subject: pe
title: Deviance: Gamesmanship vs Sportsmanship
welcome_lead: Where does competitive cunning end and cheating begin?
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on positive and negative deviance in sport.
final_note: Gamesmanship bends rules; cheating breaks them — but the line moves with culture.

concepts.def: Over-conformity to sport norms (e.g., playing through injury).
Bending rules without breaking them to gain advantage.
Fair, respectful conduct upholding the spirit of the game.
Manipulating outcomes for financial gain; criminal offence.
Shared expectations of behaviour within a sport.

walkthroughs.body_html: Coakley distinguishes positive deviance (over-conforming) and negative deviance (rule-breaking).
Time-wasting, sledging, simulating injury — within rules but ethically questionable.
2010 Pakistan cricket spot-fixing scandal showed organised crime can corrupt elite sport.
